_readme: Every QR code you hand out is one entry here. Nothing else can make a card.
The key is the slug and becomes the URL: 'besho' -> yoursite.com/besho
Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Reserved: index, admin, assets, js, data, vendor, qr, api, card.
TWO KINDS OF ENTRY — both carry a message you write:
1) READY CARD — you know who it's for.
2) ASK CARD — the person types their own name when they scan.
Put {{name}} anywhere in the message and it becomes what they typed.
Easiest way to edit: npm run admin
Then: npm run deploy   (saving is not the same as publishing)

front.en: to {{name}} — i did not deal with u alot, but it was a pleasure, i truly hope we meet somwhere somehow for a reason in the future, byeeeee

back.ar: What ever u build next, i know it will be good , keep up , and keep in touch
